nodes.name: APIGatewayModule
nodes.description: Entry point for all external requests, handling routing, authentication, and initial request validation including idempotency key checks before forwarding to specific BFFs or application services.
responsibilities: Route incoming requests
Authenticate and authorize users
Validate idempotency keys to prevent duplicate processing
Apply rate limiting and security policies

nodes.name: B2BUserBFFModule
nodes.description: Backend-for-Frontend module tailored specifically for B2B user interfaces, providing optimized API endpoints and data transformations for B2B user experiences.
responsibilities: Expose B2B user-specific payment initiation APIs
Aggregate and transform data for B2B user dashboards and reports
Handle B2B user-specific presentation logic

nodes.name: MerchantBFFModule
nodes.description: Backend-for-Frontend module tailored specifically for merchant interfaces, providing optimized API endpoints and data transformations for merchant experiences.
responsibilities: Expose merchant-specific payment and reconciliation APIs
Aggregate and transform data for merchant dashboards and reports
Handle merchant-specific presentation logic

nodes.name: PaymentProcessingUseCase
nodes.description: Orchestrates the creation and processing of payment transactions, including bank ACH and credit card transfers, applying application-specific business rules.
responsibilities: Validate payment requests against business rules
Initiate payment workflows (ACH, Credit Card)
Interact with PaymentTransactionAggregate to apply changes
Handle idempotency key validation and state management

nodes.name: ReconciliationUseCase
nodes.description: Manages the automated reconciliation process, comparing internal payment records with external statements to ensure zero balance leakage.
responsibilities: Fetch internal payment transaction data
Retrieve external payment statements from gateways
Generate reconciliation reports and identify discrepancies
Ensure zero balance leakage through reconciliation logic

nodes.name: PaymentQueryUseCase
nodes.description: Provides read operations for payment transactions, reconciliation reports, and related data, serving the presentation layer (BFFs).
responsibilities: Retrieve detailed payment transaction information
Query and filter reconciliation reports
Provide aggregated payment statistics

nodes.name: PaymentTransactionAggregate
nodes.description: Represents the core business logic and state for a payment transaction, including ACH and Credit Card transfers, managed via Event Sourcing to ensure strict ACID consistency.
responsibilities: Enforce core business rules for payment lifecycle (e.g., state transitions)
Generate domain events (e.g., PaymentInitiated, PaymentCompleted)
Validate transaction data and states
Maintain strict immediate ACID consistency for its state changes

nodes.name: ReconciliationReportEntity
nodes.description: Represents the domain model for a reconciliation report, encapsulating its state and business rules for accurate discrepancy identification.
responsibilities: Define the structure and content of reconciliation reports
Enforce business rules for report generation and discrepancy handling
Track reconciliation status and outcomes

nodes.name: IdempotencyKeyService
nodes.description: Domain service responsible for managing and validating idempotency keys to prevent duplicate processing of payment transactions.
responsibilities: Generate and validate idempotency keys
Ensure uniqueness of idempotency keys for transactions
Manage the lifecycle and state of idempotency keys

nodes.name: PaymentEventStoreRepository
nodes.description: Adapter for persisting and retrieving events related to PaymentTransactionAggregate from the EventStoreDatabase, ensuring ACID properties for event persistence.
responsibilities: Append new events to the event stream for PaymentTransactionAggregate
Load aggregate state by replaying events from the event stream
Ensure transactional integrity (ACID) when persisting events

nodes.name: ReconciliationReportRepository
nodes.description: Adapter for persisting and retrieving ReconciliationReportEntity instances to and from the ReconciliationDatabase.
responsibilities: Store generated reconciliation reports
Retrieve reports for querying and auditing

nodes.name: IdempotencyKeyRepository
nodes.description: Adapter for persisting and retrieving idempotency keys and their associated transaction states from the IdempotencyKeyDatabase.
responsibilities: Store and retrieve idempotency keys
Update idempotency key states (e.g., pending, completed)

nodes.name: ACHProcessorGateway
nodes.description: Interface/adapter for interacting with external Bank ACH Networks, abstracting away external API details.
responsibilities: Translate internal payment requests to ACH network format
Send ACH transfer requests to the external network
Process and translate ACH network responses and callbacks

nodes.name: CreditCardProcessorGateway
nodes.description: Interface/adapter for interacting with external Credit Card Processors, abstracting away external API details.
responsibilities: Translate internal payment requests to credit card processor format
Send credit card authorization and capture requests
Process and translate credit card processor responses and webhooks

nodes.name: EventStoreDatabase
nodes.description: The persistent storage for all domain events, serving as the single source of truth for payment transactions. Must support ACID properties for event append operations.
responsibilities: Store event streams for PaymentTransactionAggregate
Ensure data integrity, durability, and strict immediate ACID consistency for event writes
Provide an immutable audit log for PCI-DSS compliance

nodes.name: ReconciliationDatabase
nodes.description: Database for storing reconciliation reports and potentially read models/projections derived from the Event Store for efficient querying.
responsibilities: Store generated reconciliation reports
Provide optimized queryable access to reconciliation data

nodes.name: IdempotencyKeyDatabase
nodes.description: Database for storing idempotency keys and their associated transaction states to prevent duplicate processing.
responsibilities: Store idempotency keys and their current processing status
Provide fast lookup for idempotency key validation

nodes.name: PCIComplianceModule
nodes.description: Cross-cutting module providing services for PCI-DSS compliance, such as data encryption, tokenization, secure logging, and access control.
responsibilities: Encrypt and decrypt sensitive payment data
Tokenize credit card numbers
Implement secure logging and auditing mechanisms
Enforce access control policies for sensitive data

nodes.name: BankACHNetwork
nodes.description: External banking network for processing Automated Clearing House (ACH) transfers.
responsibilities: Process ACH debits and credits between bank accounts
Provide transaction status updates and settlement information

nodes.name: CreditCardProcessors
nodes.description: External third-party services for authorizing, capturing, and settling credit card transactions.
responsibilities: Authorize and capture credit card payments
Handle refunds, voids, and chargebacks
Provide transaction details and settlement reports

edges.payload_description: B2B user payment requests, dashboard query parameters
edges.justification: API Gateway routes B2B user-specific requests to the B2B User BFF for payment initiation and dashboard data retrieval.

edges.payload_description: Merchant payment requests, reconciliation report query parameters
edges.justification: API Gateway routes merchant-specific requests to the Merchant BFF for payment initiation and reconciliation report access.

edges.payload_description: Payment initiation command {payment_type, amount, details, idempotency_key}
edges.justification: B2B User BFF delegates payment processing requests to the Payment Processing Use Case.

edges.payload_description: Payment initiation command {payment_type, amount, details, idempotency_key}
edges.justification: Merchant BFF delegates payment processing requests to the Payment Processing Use Case.
B2B User BFF retrieves payment and reconciliation data for dashboards from the Payment Query Use Case.
Merchant BFF retrieves payment and reconciliation data for reports from the Payment Query Use Case.

edges.payload_description: Idempotency key, transaction context for validation
edges.justification: Payment Processing Use Case utilizes the Idempotency Key Service to validate and manage idempotency keys for transactions.
Idempotency Key Service interacts with the Idempotency Key Repository to persist and retrieve idempotency key states.
Idempotency Key Repository reads idempotency key states from the database for validation.

edges.payload_description: Idempotency key records for storage and state updates
edges.justification: Idempotency Key Repository writes and updates idempotency key states in the database.

edges.payload_description: Payment command data for aggregate state change
edges.justification: Payment Processing Use Case interacts with the Payment Transaction Aggregate to apply business rules and state changes, ensuring ACID consistency.
Payment Transaction Aggregate persists its state changes as domain events via the Payment Event Store Repository, ensuring ACID and auditability.
Payment Event Store Repository appends new events to the Event Store Database, ensuring transactional integrity and an immutable audit log.

edges.payload_description: Event stream data for replaying aggregate state
edges.justification: Payment Event Store Repository loads aggregate state by replaying events from the Event Store Database and provides data for queries and reconciliation.
Payment Processing Use Case delegates ACH payment requests to the ACH Processor Gateway.
Payment Processing Use Case delegates credit card payment requests to the Credit Card Processor Gateway.
ACH Processor Gateway communicates with the external Bank ACH Network to process transfers.
Credit Card Processor Gateway communicates with external Credit Card Processors.
ACH Processor Gateway uses the PCI Compliance Module for secure handling and tokenization of sensitive payment data.
Credit Card Processor Gateway uses the PCI Compliance Module for secure handling and tokenization of sensitive payment data.

edges.payload_description: Query for payment events/transactions for reconciliation
edges.justification: Reconciliation Use Case fetches internal transaction data from the Payment Event Store Repository for reconciliation.
Reconciliation Use Case retrieves external ACH statements from the ACH Processor Gateway.

edges.payload_description: Request for credit card settlement reports/statements
edges.justification: Reconciliation Use Case retrieves external credit card statements from the Credit Card Processor Gateway.

edges.payload_description: Reconciliation data for report generation and discrepancy handling
edges.justification: Reconciliation Use Case interacts with the Reconciliation Report Entity to generate and manage reconciliation reports and discrepancies.
Reconciliation Use Case persists generated reconciliation reports via the Reconciliation Report Repository.
Reconciliation Report Repository stores generated reconciliation reports in the Reconciliation Database.
Reconciliation Report Repository retrieves reports from the Reconciliation Database for querying and auditing.
Payment Query Use Case queries the Payment Event Store Repository to retrieve detailed payment transaction information.
Payment Query Use Case queries the Reconciliation Report Repository to retrieve reconciliation reports.
